title:
HE WAS BORN WITH A
SEVERE HEART CONDITION
note: Save a Child's Heart, version 2 - JULIUS IN HIS OWN VOICE. Deliberately not a reshuffle of sa-heart-julius: that cut is framed by Tal's presenter lines and ends on a Miracle coda. This one is the sit-down only (C0644/C0645) plus his own intro: Julius starts, the hook is Tal's question 'did you feel lonely?' and his answer, no presenter VO, no second child, new lines (seeing the other children, his dream), ~50s, and it ends on his close-up message to the world. Same rotation facts as sa-heart-julius (heads-left Sony -> auto transpose=1). No music. Framing pinned full-frame on Sony two-shots, 1.3x on Julius when he speaks alone (face-aim cropped the speaker out in sa-heart-julius). Straddling caption segments split in the aligned transcript cache (backup <id>.json.pre-split).
beats: HOOK (C0644): Tal: 'Did you feel lonely?' - Julius: 'Yeah, I was so lonely.' Two faces, a question and its answer as one unit, in the first 3s.
WHO (C0635): 'Hi, I'm Julius and this is my story.'

WHY (C0644): 'When I was still growing up, until 10 years old, I felt some challenges, difficulty breathing, I could get tired, sweating at night.' Starts on 'when' - 29.40 landed inside 'old' (speech energy 28.75-29.55).
WHAT IT TOOK FROM HIM (C0644): 'I was facing such signs. I couldn't play with my friends, having fun.' - 'You couldn't?' - 'Yeah, doing sports.' This answers the hook.

FAITH (C0645, one continuous take): 'So my father told me that... when, when, when... once we were in Jerusalem, told me I should believe I'm already healed before the surgery. So I did and we prayed, and I thank God it went well.' The hesitation is KEPT: cutting it split the sentence across a jump (verify-cut: ends mid-thought on 'that'), and it reads as him gathering himself before the line that matters.
NOW (C0644): Tal: 'How does it make you feel seeing all these other children getting...' - 'Yeah, I'm really excited. I'm really excited to see them.' He is on the other side of it now; Tal smiles.
THE FUTURE (C0644): 'And what's your dream?' - 'My dream is to become an IT.' (sic - IT specialist; captioned as said)
HIS LAST WORD (C0645, close-up): Tal: 'What's your message to the world?' - 'Okay. I can say people should not give up and should believe in God.' Ends on his face.
